notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating either a 2/2 Cat or a 3/1 Dog creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Cat or Dog.
The Cat or Dog dies, triggering Black Market Tycoon, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
